name: trippy
readme_summary: Trippy is a network diagnostic tool written in Rust that combines the functionalities of ping and traceroute. It provides real-time network performance analysis and troubleshooting capabilities through a user-friendly terminal interface.
key_features: Multiple installation methods (cargo, package managers, binaries)
cover_image_prompt: A wise old cartographer in a dimly lit study, meticulously drawing a complex network map. Instead of traditional ink, they use glowing lines of data emanating from a digital tablet displaying network packets. The map shows interconnected nodes representing servers and routers, with some paths highlighted in red to indicate issues and others in green for healthy connections. Small, stylized icons of a ping ball and a traceroute arrow are subtly integrated into the map's legend. The overall mood is one of focused investigation and problem-solving, with a touch of digital magic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a dark, atmospheric background and vibrant, glowing data lines.

name: winpodx
readme_summary: WinPodX provides a seamless way to run Windows applications as native Linux applications. It leverages FreeRDP RemoteApp and a zero-configuration setup to integrate Windows apps directly into your Linux desktop environment, complete with proper icons and taskbar pinning.
key_features: Run Windows apps as native Linux windows
Real icons and WM_CLASS for Windows apps
Pin Windows apps to the Linux taskbar
Live Pod/RAM/CPU gauges and workspace tiles in a dashboard
primary_use_case: To allow Linux users to run and integrate Windows applications directly into their desktop environment as if they were native Linux applications.
cover_image_prompt: A digital artist sitting at a clean, modern desk, holding a paintbrush that is seamlessly merging a Windows application icon (like Microsoft Word) with a Linux desktop environment icon (like a KDE plasma orb). The paintbrush tip glows, showing the transformation. On the desk, a tablet displays a live dashboard with CPU and RAM usage graphs, and a small, stylized 'WinPodX' logo. The background is a blurred view of a Linux desktop. The overall mood is one of effortless integration and productivity. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft, ambient lighting and a clean, vibrant color palette.

name: WailBrew
description: Minimalistic Homebrew GUI made with Go, Wails and React.
readme_summary: WailBrew is a native macOS graphical user interface for managing Homebrew packages, casks, and services. It provides an intuitive, modern alternative to command-line package management, allowing users to install, update, and control their software with ease.
key_features: Supports bulk operations (multi-select, all at once)
Signed and notarized for macOS distribution
primary_use_case: To provide a user-friendly graphical interface for managing Homebrew packages on macOS, making software installation and updates more accessible.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized whale character, representing 'WailBrew', is comfortably seated at a desk in a cozy, modern macOS environment. The whale is holding a digital tablet that displays a clean, organized list of software icons (representing Homebrew packages). With a gentle wave of its fin, the whale is shown 'installing' a new software icon onto a stylized representation of a Mac computer in the scene, which glows with a soft, welcoming light. Subtle digital particles and clean UI elements float around the whale, indicating software management. The overall mood is helpful and efficient, with a clean, bright aesthetic. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with soft lighting and clear, friendly character design.

name: claude-code-showcase
description: Comprehensive Claude Code project configuration example with hooks, skills, agents, commands, and GitHub Actions workflows
readme_summary: This repository showcases a comprehensive configuration example for Claude Code, an LLM agent, demonstrating how to integrate custom skills, agents, hooks, and GitHub Actions for automated code quality, review, and maintenance. It aims to highlight the power of LLM agents in software development by automating repetitive tasks and enforcing project standards.
key_features: Custom skills for explaining project conventions (UI libraries, testing, GraphQL)
Hooks for automated code formatting, testing, type-checking, and branch protection
Code review agent with detailed checklists and automated PR reviews via GitHub Actions
Scheduled GitHub workflow agents for documentation sync, code quality checks, and dependency audits
Skill evaluation system for intelligent skill suggestion based on prompt analysis
JIRA/Linear integration for ticket management, feature implementation, and bug reporting
Automated ticket triage by analyzing tickets and suggesting code implementations
primary_use_case: To provide a detailed, practical example of how to configure and leverage Claude Code for automating various aspects of software development, including code quality, reviews, maintenance, and ticket management, thereby enhancing team productivity and code consistency.
cover_image_prompt: A master craftsman, embodying 'Claude Code', meticulously assembling a complex, intricate clockwork mechanism representing a software codebase. Gears and cogs, labeled with 'Skills', 'Agents', and 'Hooks', turn in perfect synchrony, guided by the craftsman's precise movements. Input scrolls of raw code are fed into one side, and perfectly formed, polished code components emerge from the other, glowing with efficiency. Subtle digital particles and faint lines of code float around the scene, connecting the mechanical metaphor to the digital world. The overall mood is one of intelligent automation and precision. The scene is set in a well-lit, organized workshop, rendered in a detailed 3D isometric illustration style.

name: VidBee
description: Download video and audio from  YouTube ,  TikTok ,  Twitter ,  Instagram ,  Facebook ,  Twitch ,  Bilibili , and 1000+ sites—or import local media. Create searchable transcripts on your computer, then summarize, translate, or ask questions with your preferred AI provider.
readme_summary: VidBee is a desktop application for downloading and organizing video and audio from over 1000 websites. It allows users to create searchable transcripts locally, summarize, translate, and query media using AI, while also supporting local media import and flexible export options.
key_features: Download video and audio from 1000+ sites
Summarize, translate, and ask questions with AI
Support for local AI models (Whisper, SenseVoice, Parakeet, Qwen3-ASR)
primary_use_case: To download, organize, transcribe, and analyze video and audio content from various online sources and local files using AI.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing a vast, magical library filled with glowing video reels and audio scrolls. The librarian is using a futuristic tablet that projects holographic transcripts and AI-generated summaries. Bookshelves are labeled with icons of popular social media and video platforms. Subtle digital particles representing data flow from the reels to the tablet. The repository name 'VidBee' is subtly etched on the librarian's spectacles. The scene is set in a cozy, dimly lit study with warm, inviting light. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with rich details and a slightly whimsical, approachable feel.
